validated_results.title: Dietary fat and prostate cancer.
validated_results.reason: This is a critical review appraising "All 33 published case-control and cohort studies" of dietary fat and prostate cancer rather than an original human study.

validated_results.title: Genetic variations in the vitamin D receptor, androgen receptor and enzymes that regulate androgen metabolism.
validated_results.reason: The article states "We review the current literature" using a MEDLINE search on vitamin D receptor and androgen gene variations, so it is a narrative review without original exposure data.

validated_results.title: Selenium: epidemiology and basic science.
validated_results.reason: Published epidemiological and basic science studies of selenium "are reviewed and summarized," making this a narrative review rather than a primary study.

validated_results.title: Vitamin A, retinoids and carotenoids as chemopreventive agents for prostate cancer.
validated_results.reason: The paper reviews in vitro, animal, observational, and experimental studies of carotenoids, so beta-carotene evidence is secondary review material.

validated_results.title: Vitamin A, retinoids and carotenoids as chemopreventive agents for prostate cancer.
validated_results.reason: Lycopene findings are summarized from previously published epidemiological and experimental studies in a narrative review format.

validated_results.title: Vitamin A, retinoids and carotenoids as chemopreventive agents for prostate cancer.
validated_results.reason: Statements about tomato products derive from "inconsistent though intriguing evidence from epidemiological studies" reviewed rather than newly collected data.

validated_results.title: Vitamin A, retinoids and carotenoids as chemopreventive agents for prostate cancer.
validated_results.reason: Vitamin A and retinoid evidence is appraised from existing in vitro, animal, and human studies in this review article.

validated_results.title: Statistical design issues and other practical considerations for conducting phase III prostate cancer prevention trials.
validated_results.reason: The article is a methodological commentary on "statistical design issues and other practical considerations" for prevention trials, reporting no original selenium-prostate cancer results.

validated_results.title: Statistical design issues and other practical considerations for conducting phase III prostate cancer prevention trials.
validated_results.reason: Trials such as SELECT are cited only "to illustrate some statistical design features," so no primary vitamin E incidence data are presented.

validated_results.title: Prostate cancer chemoprevention agent development: the National Cancer Institute, Division of Cancer Prevention portfolio.
validated_results.reason: This is a descriptive account of the National Cancer Institute chemoprevention agent development portfolio without original selenium study results.

validated_results.title: Prostate cancer chemoprevention agent development: the National Cancer Institute, Division of Cancer Prevention portfolio.
validated_results.reason: The paper only notes that the Selenium and Vitamin E Cancer Prevention Trial is "ongoing," providing no original vitamin E incidence findings.

validated_results.title: Designing a large prevention trial: statistical issues.
validated_results.reason: The purpose is "to suggest a framework for designing a simple, large AD prevention trial," a design/methods paper with no original prostate cancer incidence results.
